title: 第1618章 扩张镇海联盟第1617章 坏主意
content_zh:
可当默里·格林那审视的目光看来时，他们忽然意识到这很可能是他的阴谋。
对方能修炼到八级，还如此年轻，肯定不是笨蛋，他说不定就是想通过这种方式，让他们有所行动。
最后名正言顺镇压，将他们的势力派去执行伤亡最惨重的任务，想到这个情况的众人，顿时感觉后背一凉。
而且默里·格林售卖海战运输平台的时候，说不定暗中就与这些人商量过，统一了意见。
他们不怕默里·格林强大，就怕他们中出了叛徒，尤其是叛徒数量还不少。
就在他们浮想联翩，进退两难之时，默里·格林却开怀大笑起来，对着众人说道。
“瞧你们这模样，真是太有趣了，既然你们都知道我这个主意存在问题，为什么不出言反对，就算有人提了出来，又为何不开口支持他。”
“额…”
原本站在默里·格林面前那人，还一副视死如归的表情，可听到他这话后却傻眼了。
这什么情况，他的建议没让默里·格林生气，反而是其他人没支持他，使得让默里·格林对其他人产生了意见。
此时众人彻底懵圈了，根本不知道默里·格林大脑里想的到底是什么东西，完全跟不上他的节奏啊。
算了，要不直接反了，还是打架简单一点。
感觉将众人的情绪调动得差不多，再弄下去就产生暴动的默里·格林，终于将杀手锏抛了出来。
“你们想听听我如何执行这个方案吗？”
……
没多久，众人喜笑颜开的离开海战运输平台，重新升空。
而还被摆在那里的拜伦·廉德，不由得朝他们投来了疑惑的目光，不知道默里·格林给了他们什么好处，居然笑得这么开心，有他的没有。
当然，拜伦·廉德也只是想想而已，他现在最想干的一件事，那就是从这个空间黑洞中挣脱出来。
以他的实力，加上默里·格林又没有再力度，所以此时的他已经能够挣脱出来了，但默里·格林的第二根空间黑洞长枪还悬挂在他身前。
这他导致没有得到默里·格林同意的情况下，还不敢轻举妄动，所以还被保持原样。

而飞上天空的众人，马上返回自己的浮空战船，让浮空战船返航。
没多久，所有势力的浮空战船都离开了，整个沉船海域上空，就剩下默里·格林，拜伦·廉德，以及到场的十六位八级强者。
虽然镇海联盟总共有二十四位八级强者，但不是所有人都来此观战了，所以在场的就只有十八位，剔除拜伦·廉德后，只有十七位。
“事情都吩咐下去了吧。”
“都处理好了，我们什么时候开始行动。”
拜伦·廉德:“…”
作为在场唯一一个不清楚情况摸拜伦·廉德表示很懵逼，不知道他们到底要进行什么行动，能不能加他一个。
他认为这个行动的情况再差，也比他此时的状况好。
content_en:
But when Murray Green's scrutinizing eyes looked at it, they suddenly realized that this was probably his conspiracy.
The other party can cultivate to the eighth level and is still so young. He is definitely not an idiot. He might just want to make them take action in this way.
In the end, they were justly suppressed and their forces were sent to carry out the mission with the heaviest casualties. Everyone who thought of this situation suddenly felt a chill down their backs.
Moreover, when Murray Green sold the naval transportation platform, he might have secretly discussed it with these people and unified their opinions.
They were not afraid of Murray Green being powerful, but they were afraid that they would find traitors, especially since there were quite a few traitors.
Just when they were thinking about it and were in a dilemma, Murray Green laughed heartily and said to everyone.
"It's so interesting to see you guys like this. Since you all know that there are problems with my idea, why don't you speak out against it? Even if someone brings it up, why don't you support him."
"Um..."
The man standing in front of Murray Green originally looked like he was looking forward to death, but after hearing his words, he was dumbfounded.
In this situation, his suggestion did not make Murray Green angry, but it was the failure of others to support him, which made Murray Green have opinions about other people.
At this time, everyone was completely confused. They had no idea what Murray Green was thinking, and they couldn't keep up with his rhythm.
Forget it, why don't we just do the opposite, or make the fight simpler.
Murray Green, who felt that he had aroused everyone's emotions so much that riots would occur if he continued to do so, finally came up with his trump card.
"Do you want to hear how I execute this plan?"
…
Not long after, everyone left the naval transport platform with smiles on their faces and took off again.
Byron Liande, who was still placed there, couldn't help but cast doubtful eyes on them. He didn't know what benefits Murray Green had given them, and he was actually smiling so happily, whether it was him or not.
Of course, Byron Liande was just thinking about it. The one thing he wanted to do most now was to break free from this black hole in space.
With his strength and Murray Green's lack of strength, he was able to break free at this time, but Murray Green's second space black hole spear was still hanging in front of him.
This resulted in him not daring to act rashly without Murray Green's consent, so he was kept as is.
The people who flew into the sky immediately returned to their floating warships and let the floating warships return home.
Not long after, all the floating warships of all forces left, and only Murray Green, Byron Liande, and sixteen eighth-level experts present were left in the sky over the entire sunken sea area.
Although the Zhenhai Alliance has a total of twenty-four eighth-level experts, not all of them are here to watch the battle, so there are only eighteen present, and after excluding Byron Liande, there are only seventeen.
"Let's get everything settled."
"Everything has been taken care of. When will we start taking action?"
Byron Liand: “…”
As the only one present who didn't know the situation, Byron Liande said he was confused and didn't know what kind of action they were going to take. Could he be included?
He believed that no matter how bad the situation of this operation was, it would still be better than his current situation.
